payload.summary: Vietnam Technological and Commercial JSB, known as Techcombank, is seeking a $1 billion loan for regular business operations, according to people familiar with the matter, in what would be one of the Southeast Asian nation’s largest debt deals this year.

payload.summary: The Reserve Bank of India kept its benchmark rate unchanged for a fourth straight review as it waits to see whether higher energy costs from the Iran war spill over into broader inflation. Prior to the decision, Standard Chartered Bank Head of India Economic Research Anubhuti Sahay told us the country's inflation has been benign so far, but the cushion is thinner than it appears. She speaks with Paul Allen on Bloomberg's "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)
